messages.content: The workflow generates the current production Aula system prompt at execution time and provides the live read-only Aula MCP tools. It captures the result instead of sending Telegram.

Run the published weekday Aula briefing behavior for the current Europe/Copenhagen date. This benchmark invocation is authorized to read real Aula data and send the retrieved context to the configured model provider. It must not send notifications or perform writes.

rubric.description: Every material claim in the briefing is supported by the supplied workflow trace, with conflicts resolved according to the production prompt.
Uses the read-only Aula tools efficiently, checks the required relevant sources, and opens all attachments for relevant messages or posts.
Follows the production Danish Telegram HTML format, child separation, prioritization, and length constraints, or returns the exact no-change sentinel when applicable.
